## WSFS Bank Names Equipment Finance Leader Miles Herman President of NewLane Finance


11/17/2026


Download (opens in new window)


WILMINGTON, Del.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


WSFS Bank, the primary subsidiary of WSFS Financial Corporation (Nasdaq: WSFS), today announced the appointment of Miles Herman as President of NewLane Finance, its national equipment finance subsidiary. Herman brings more than three decades of equipment finance leadership to the role and will lead NewLane's strategy, operations, and growth while deepening its alignment with the broader WSFS franchise. He will report to Jim Wechsler, Executive Vice President and Chief Commercial Banking Officer at WSFS Bank.


Herman joins NewLane from LEAF Commercial Capital, Inc., a leading U.S. equipment finance company and a subsidiary of M&T Bank. He co-founded LEAF in 2001 and has served as its Chief Executive Officer since 2023. Before that, he served as LEAF's President and Chief Operating Officer, where he oversaw the company's growth and its integration into M&T Bank's commercial ecosystem.


“Miles has spent his career building and leading equipment finance businesses, and he brings deep industry expertise, operational rigor, and people-first leadership that make him the ideal leader for NewLane’s next stage of growth,” said Wechsler. “We’re excited to welcome him to WSFS and look forward to the next chapter he’ll help write for our team, our partners, and the clients we serve.”


Beyond his executive role, Herman plays an active leadership role across the industry. He currently serves as Chair of the Board of Trustees for the Equipment Leasing & Finance Foundation (ELFF), following a term as Vice Chair. He has also served on the Executive Committee of the Board of Directors for the Equipment Leasing & Finance Association (ELFA), playing an integral part in shaping strategy and industry-wide initiatives.


“NewLane has built an impressive platform with a talented team and already has a positive reputation for speed and service,” said Herman. “I’m honored to join an organization with a strong foundation for growth and excited to build on our momentum to scale our platform, deepen our partnerships, and deliver even stronger results for the businesses we serve.”


**About WSFS Financial Corporation**


WSFS Financial Corporation is a multibillion-dollar financial services company. Its primary subsidiary, WSFS Bank, is the oldest and largest locally headquartered bank and wealth management franchise in the Greater Philadelphia and Delaware region. As of September 30, 2026, WSFS Financial Corporation had $22.1 billion in assets on its balance sheet and $109.5 billion in assets under management and administration. WSFS operates from 115 offices, 87 of which are banking offices, located in Pennsylvania (59), Delaware (38), New Jersey (14), Florida (2), Nevada (1) and Virginia (1) and provides comprehensive financial services including commercial banking, consumer banking, treasury management, and trust and wealth management. Other subsidiaries or divisions include Arrow Land Transfer, Bryn Mawr Trust Advisors, LLC, Bryn Mawr Trust®, The Bryn Mawr Trust Company of Delaware, Cash Connect®, NewLane Finance®, WSFS Wealth® Management, LLC, WSFS Institutional Services®, and WSFS Mortgage®. Serving the Greater Delaware Valley since 1832, WSFS Bank is one of the ten oldest banks in the United States continuously operating under the same name.
